thread:
elaine: saw a small cluster of quota mismatches this afternoon. some origins show requests >> issued tokens. looks tied to auth-proxy labeling. anyone else see this?
marco: saw that too. initial clues point to claim caching outliving token lifetime — proxy reuses claim label after token regen.
ravi: sample log: `proxy: token_id=tk_4b8, claim_epoch=42, claim_hash=0xabc, token_ttl=25s, cache_ttl=120s` -> cache > ttl. proxy keeps labeling new requests with old claim_epoch.
henry: nice find. two quick mitigations: (A) make the proxy drop cached claim when token expiry is observed, (B) introduce a claim_epoch label that increments on token issue so overlapping cache windows don't collapse into the same label.
elaine: i prefer B since it's safer for perf (don't flush caches aggressively). we can add claim_epoch to metrics and canonicalize by `(claim_hash, claim_epoch)`. that should make attribution unambiguous.
marco: agree on epoch label. telemetry ask: add `claim_epoch` + `claim_hash` to `api_requests_total` and emit `auth_proxy_claim_epoch_mismatch_total` whenever we detect request attributed to an epoch older than token issuance.
ravi: proposed promql to detect surplus per claim-epoch: `sum by (claim_hash, claim_epoch) (increase(api_requests_total{handler="proxy"}[10m])) - sum by (claim_hash, claim_epoch) (increase(token_issued_total[10m]))` then filter where result > 0. that surfaces exact epochs with over-attribution.
henry: on the console side, show a small discrepancy badge on the quota dashboard row when requests/issued > 1.2 and link to a diagnostic modal that shows top claim_hash+epoch and a mini timeline. also add a shortline: "Possible proxy label reuse — see runbook."
elaine: rollout plan: behind flag `auth.proxy.claim_epoch=true`, canary 0.5% traffic for 30m, then 5% for 1h. gating: discrepancy ratio <= 1.05 for all active claim epochs and no `auth_proxy_claim_epoch_mismatch_total` > 0 in canary. if any mismatch > 0, increase sampling of traces to 25% for the affected origin and hold.
marco: i'll draft the PR: add label, metric, feature flag, and a prometheus recording rule + alert. will include dashboard change as an annotation-only update.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: auth-proxy/canary -> k8s-redwood/us-east-1 (id: deploy-2026-06-02-011) :rocket:
ravi: i'll run the promql against staging and post a quick graph in ~40m. if we still see surplus after epoch labels, we should consider conservative cache eviction on token expiry.
elaine: great. once telemetry proves clean i'll work with product to add the discrepancy modal copy and runbook link. thanks all :thumbsup:
